items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: Benny Don Raymond had quit the band then

ctx.x: yeah the American cotton pickers yeah the American cotton pickers but you see I didn't like that road business so I told Mack well see Mack I got to come in I can't he can't make this road he said like that because I had a wife and Mack at that time was doing straight one-nighters see he was paying you $125 a week work or play but you worked all the whole time yeah you see very yeah yeah you see and he did alright like this see because see Benny Don Raymond had quit the band then and Benny Carter was in charge…
